Package io.micronaut.http.client.internal

@NullMarked package io.micronaut.http.client.internal
Internal helpers for asynchronous client exchanges.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    io.micronaut.http.client
    Core HTTP Client Library.
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    ElementsResponse<T>
    The response of an asynchronous streaming exchange: the status and the headers of the response, and the elements of its body as the body.
    ElementsStages
    Maps the stages of the streaming exchanges of the async clients without losing the elements: when the mapping fails, or the mapped stage was cancelled before the result arrived, the elements are closed, so that the connection is not reserved until the read timeout.
    RawHttpRequestWrapper<B>
    The request of a raw or proxied exchange: a request with the raw bytes of its body, which the clients send as they are unless a filter replaced them.
    RawResponseFuture
    The CompletableFuture of an AsyncRawHttpClient exchange.
    ResponseSubscriberElements<X,T>
    The elements of a reactive exchange that emits each piece of the body wrapped in the response, such as SseClient.exchangeEventStream or StreamingHttpClient.exchangeStream: the first emitted response completes the exchange, and each read requests the next one.
